2026_01_CHI_CAR.headline: Chicago can widen the field while Carolina replaces a missing edge defender
2026_01_CHI_CAR.paragraph1: The Bears arrive with Rome Odunze, Tyson Bagent, Ozzy Trapilo and Xavier Woods all questionable, while the Panthers ruled Patrick Jones II out but cleared Jonathon Brooks. That creates a mixed availability picture rather than a simple health advantage. Chicago’s best route is to stretch Carolina horizontally, force replacement pass-rush snaps, and keep Caleb Williams out of predictable long-yardage situations; Carolina can counter by using Brooks to sustain drives and keep the Bears’ offense on the sideline.
2026_01_CHI_CAR.model_rationale: Chicago has the cleaner path if its spacing game neutralizes Carolina’s thinner edge rotation and keeps the offense ahead of the chains throughout the afternoon.
